title: Backfill the 6.0 changelog for every PR from #630 onward, and record in ci-confidence.md what the release lane has actually executed versus only reasoned about
description: Backfill the 6.0 changelog for every PR from #630 onward, and record in ci-confidence.md what the release lane has actually executed versus only reasoned about
no_spec_change_rationale: Both files are prose about behaviour that already shipped; no canonical spec module changes, and no requirement gains, loses or alters a guarantee.
acceptance_criteria: Every merged PR from #630 through #727 either has a CHANGELOG entry under [Unreleased] or is deliberately omitted with a stated reason; no entry describes a mechanism the diff does not support; and docs/ci-confidence.md states which release-lane jobs have actually executed, which have not, and what a promote failure costs.
